LESSON: ADDITION

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.3: Addition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Addition. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-097.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 97]]

From your pupil's book (page 97)

NUMBERS ADDITION Week 4 Lesson 2 Add Activity Add

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-164.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 164]]

From your pupil's book (page 164)

TERM 3 Week 5 Lesson 2 Subtraction and addition Activity Write subtraction as addition 13 - 6 = Write as 6 + = 13 Count on from 6 to 13. There are 7 steps. 6 + 7 = 13 13 - 6 = 7 Work to do Fill in missing number

1. 17 - 9 = 8 9 + 8 = 17 2. 9 - 4 = 4 + = 9 3. 12 - 5 = 5 + = 12 4. 14 - 8 = 8 + = 14 150

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-031.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 31]]

From your pupil's book (page 31)

NUMBERS ADDITION Week 3 Lesson 5 Putting together

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Addition means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Addition.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Addition
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
